text_block_list.text:
While on the move with Gold City. She's 
been holding her head in pain for a while 
now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, geez, this is the worst... Even the 
medicine isn't doing anything at all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I just have a bit of a headache.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It happens sometimes when I do modeling 
work. Yesterday's shoot had particularly 
harsh lighting.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it's not the first time, so you 
don't need to worry."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ but I have a photoshoot today too... I 
hope the medicine kicks in before then.

Gold City ended up suffering from a 
headache for quite a while afterward.
